layman_headline: Crypto market is in fear mode — patience beats impulsiveness right now.
layman_explanation: The overall crypto market has been sliding for about a week, with Bitcoin down nearly 4% and most altcoins doing worse. The market mood index reads 28 out of 100, firmly in 'Fear' territory, and it's been getting worse all week. Negative news around a Coldcard hardware wallet exploit and Bitcoin hitting $62K with a sustained negative Coinbase premium are adding to the anxiety. None of the coins on the watchlist present a clean, high-conviction setup right now.
layman_action: Stay on the sidelines with cash ready. If AAVE drops closer to $85 or the Fear & Greed index dips below 20, that could create a better buying opportunity. Don't chase anything in this environment.
expert_reasoning: The Fear & Greed index at 28 with a worsening weekly trend (avg 27.6) signals the market hasn't found a bottom yet. Per my validated rules, readings near 25 make the short-term outlook genuinely ambiguous, so a HOLD is warranted. BTC dominance at 56.2% is hostile to altcoins — capital is rotating into Bitcoin, not out of it. The Coinbase premium hitting a 77-day negative streak (CoinTelegraph) confirms persistent US institutional selling pressure. Among candidates, KAITO has bearish chart patterns with overbought RSI despite a -20% day — a classic falling knife. TRUMP has an oversold RSI of 26, which per signal credibility data (RSI 71% win rate) is normally attractive, but the chart is bearish, it's at -98% from ATH, and this is a meme token with no fundamental floor. UB has had a 130% 5-day run — chasing that is high risk. AAVE at RSI 49 with DeFi fundamentals is the cleanest potential setup, but needs a deeper pullback or a catalyst to trigger entry.
risk_factors: Fear & Greed continues worsening toward extreme fear (sub-20), triggering broader capitulation selling
Coldcard exploit news could expand into broader security concerns, accelerating outflows from crypto
BTC dominance continues rising, crushing altcoin valuations further regardless of individual merit
watch_list: Fear & Greed Index — watch for a drop below 20 which historically precedes sharp reversals
AAVE price action near $85-88 support zone for a higher-conviction entry
Bitcoin Coinbase premium — if it turns positive, it signals US institutional buying returning
market_context: Bitcoin at $62.8K with a 77-day negative Coinbase premium streak and Fear at 28 — the market is in a slow bleed with no clear reversal signal yet. High BTC dominance at 56.2% makes altcoin entries especially risky.
context_banner: Market fear is building with no reversal catalyst in sight — capital preservation is the priority until sentiment stabilizes.
